source.source_name: data.govmu.org — List of ICT Companies in Mauritius (Open Data)
source.organization: Mauritius (publisher MDPA), via the national open-data portal (CKAN)

parsing.notes: Single open CSV (CC-BY-SA-4.0, ~1,060 rows). Encoding is Windows-1252 (cp1252) — NOT UTF-8; decode accordingly. Columns: Title, Address, District, Sectors, Other Related Sectors. Sectors is newline-separated free-text within the cell. No identifier (no BRN), no status, no dates. Sectoral (ICT) coverage only. Discover the latest resource URL via the data.govmu.org CKAN package_search if the file id changes. Join to CBRD by name.

mapping_rules.activity_code: Sectors (split on newline) + Other Related Sectors (free-text, no code list).

live_test_plan.smoke: Download ict_companies.csv (cp1252) and parse the 5 columns; expect ~1,060 rows.
live_test_plan.full: Ingest the full CSV; split Sectors on newline; join to CBRD by name for identifiers.
